values.note: Call 9 am to 5 pm (386-497-2150 or toll-free 866-224-2064); no online booking. A one-night deposit (two on holiday weekends) holds the site; no refunds, credit only with 30 days' notice. Weekend 2-night minimum (Fri/Sat) Memorial Day to Labor Day, none off-season; 3 nights on a Monday-holiday weekend. Late arrivals with a reservation may set up and check in next morning.

note: Canoe/tube livery with a campground 1/4 mi west of Ichetucknee Springs State Park's north entrance, 8587 SW Elim Church Rd, Fort White. Shady sites with picnic table, grill and fire ring, plus tent areas and rustic cabins; bathhouse, game room. Rents tubes/canoes/kayaks for the Ichetucknee & Santa Fe Rivers. Pets only with an RV or camper.
